searchText: Yeah, there is definitely a trade-off between reorg free follow distance and reorgs handling in the deposits' logic <@340345049063882753> <@476250636548308992> I've made a PR to update EIP-4881. Would love to hear your feedback if you guys have any! https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/5443 Structure looks good. I haven't tried to verify the code changes involved yet. And as usual the EIP requirements appear to have changed again and created a bunch of busy work for you. 😄 Well it passes the test cases :D Yeah.. I don't like not being able to include a link to the `eth2-specs` repo That will always be a valid link And it's necessary for reference Another link it didn't like was to the discussion on eth-magicians.. but that link is already in the EIP header so it should be fine to have in other places I hope the maintainers will let me just push it through Apparently it also doesn't like Standardized in the description either. I do like it insisting you can't call a file eip4881.py though. Well python won't let me call it eip-4881.py I had to call it eip_4881.py which is arguably worse
